reason: On books.je-create, Tab reaches the Date textbox (mercury-utils-id-50) after 101 stops and focus alone opens the calendar; on books.je-date-picker Tab reaches the same textbox at its new place in the calendar's portal (value Oct 4, 2026), which is why the sweep's form xpath is absent from its trace. The claim that Tab never focuses the textbox is false, although focus then falls to the page body, which this finding does not cover.

The previous month arrow in the Date calendar has no text, aria-label, aria-labelledby or title and its icon is aria-hidden, so it is announced as an unnamed button and fails 4.1.2. The named Date textbox next to it takes a typed date (12/31/2099 moved the calendar to December 2099) and the day cells are not focusable, so the arrows are not the only way to set the date: low.
